name: hazel_weir_central_procedural_graph
description: Optimized Central Procedural Graph featuring Proactive Peak Market Monetization, sprinted early-game workforce scaling, extended Day 30 Town Shop arbitrage, bounded land expansion, and adjacent cluster harvesting.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, active shop contract demand, commodity price ratios relative to base price, and oracle price drop signals across market commodities.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces dynamic cash reserve locks and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Preemptively matches unlocked town shop demand surges and immediately fulfills mature high-margin crops (Carrots, Tomatoes, Pumpkins, Strawberries) through Day 30 to capture 2.0x-3.5x contract price premiums.

nodes.name: Proactive Market Peak Monetization
nodes.description: Routinely monetizes uncommitted shed surplus at cyclical peak prices (>= 1.05x - 1.25x base price) using 1-2 market slots, maintaining a lean shed (35%-60%) and capturing high margins before opponent gluts.

nodes.name: Shed Headroom Relief
nodes.description: Prevents silent 100/100 harvest discards by clearing uncommitted low-margin inventory under strict price floors while protecting animal feed and shop contracts.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast to dump sensitive commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) immediately before opponent market gluts collapse prices.

nodes.name: Capital Reinvestment & Yield Scaling
nodes.description: Reinvests surplus cash beyond wage reserves into workforce acceleration (sprinting to 10 hands by Day 4-5), bounded contiguous land expansion, commercial high-yield seeds, and fertilizer.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines with strict operational sequencing: adjacent cluster harvest, shed drop-off, crop watering, livestock feeding, pre-seeding fertilization, planting, and terminal liquidation.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases (BUY_SEED, BUY_ANIMAL, BUY_LAND, redundant HIRE); schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21; enforce emergency liquidation of non-feed, non-contract inventory at hour >= 20 to guarantee payroll.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (max(0, n_animals * 3)); do not rely on low-margin fertilizer sales to cover payroll deficits; never liquidate crops committed to active town shop delivery.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and (net_available_cash >= 120.0 or shop_deliverable_inventory > 0) and day <= 30
attributes.guidance: Allocate up to 3 market slots to deliver matching mature shed inventory directly to town shops for 2.0x-3.5x premium through Day 30; procure shop-demanded seeds (Carrots, Tomatoes, Pumpkins) only when remaining contract duration strictly exceeds crop growth days and surplus cash covers wage buffers.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not commit seed capital if net cash falls below 1.15x midnight payroll reserve; do not purchase shop seeds if shed capacity exceeds 88%; never hold shop produce past contract expiration windows; never halt contract deliveries before Day 30 when deliverable stock exists.

attributes.guidance: Allocate 1-2 open market order slots to batch-sell uncommitted shed inventory of commodities trading at cyclical peaks (current_price >= 1.05 * base_price); prioritize highest price-ratio commodities (Strawberries, Pumpkins, Tomatoes, Wool, Milk); maintain a lean 35%-60% shed baseline to prevent emergency fire-sales.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell items reserved for active town shop contracts; never liquidate Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (max(0, n_animals * 3)); never consume more than 2 order slots to preserve engine capacity for shop preempt and wage defense.

attributes.guidance: Evict pending non-urgent buy orders to free order slots; execute batch sales of unreserved, non-shop surplus holdings with price >= 0.70 * base_price; relax floor to 0.45 * base_price if shed_used >= 92 to guarantee zero silent harvest discards.
attributes.pitfalls: Never fire-sell at sub-0.50 base price unless shed_used >= 92; never liquidate Wheat below livestock feed reserve (max(0, n_animals * 3)); never evict produce allocated for active town shop fulfillment.

attributes.guidance: Preempt lowest-margin open orders; execute rapid batch liquidations of vulnerable commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) while current market price remains favorable (> 0.75 * base_price) before opponent dumping collapses market prices.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not dump into already collapsed sub-0.50 base price markets unless shed overflow is imminent; do not front-run commodities committed to active town shop contracts; never liquidate Wheat below livestock feed reserve (max(0, n_animals * 3)).

attributes.condition: ((hired_hands < 10 and net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.10 + hire_cost) or (hired_hands >= 8 and uncultivated_plots == 0 and total_plots < 18 and net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.30 + 250.0) or (has_seed_deficit and net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.15 + 40.0) or (has_fertilizer_deficit and net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.20 + 60.0)) and day <= 29
attributes.guidance: Accelerate workforce scaling to 10 hands by Day 4-5 under lean payroll buffers (1.10x midnight payroll + hire cost); acquire contiguous land plots up to 16-18 plots only when hands >= 8 and existing plots are fully cultivated; continuously procure commercial high-yield seeds (Pumpkins, Tomatoes, Strawberries) and fertilizer for all tilled plots; enforce crop maturation cutoffs: halt Pumpkin seeds Day 23, Tomatoes Day 25, Carrots Day 27.5, pivot to rapid Wheat on Days 28-29, and halt all seed buying on Day 29.
attributes.pitfalls: Never compromise the 1.10x midnight payroll reserve for reinvestment purchases; do not acquire land beyond 18 plots to prevent worker transit exhaustion; never buy seeds after Day 29; never leave tilled plots barren during peak growth days.

attributes.guidance: Dispatch active hands strictly by operational priority: 1) Harvest adjacent mature crops up to worker carrying capacity; 2) Drop off carried items at shed; 3) Water dry crops; 4) Feed hungry livestock; 5) Apply fertilizer to tilled plots; 6) Plant commercial seeds; 7) Weed clearing and ground tilling. Transition labor on Days 29-30 entirely to final watering, harvesting, and shed drop-offs, ensuring all carried inventory is deposited at shed by step 716 for terminal liquidation.
attributes.pitfalls: Never delay shed drop-offs if carried inventory blocks watering duties; never prioritize weeding over harvesting or watering; never leave ripe crops unharvested across steps; ensure zero unharvested mature crops or uncollected shed items remain at step 716.
